scope: Ordinary nonaccelerated, nonspecialized NYS K–12 reference pathway
grouping_basis: Project navigation convention; these stage bands are not asserted to be universal NYSED subject bands or district school configurations.
temporal_basis: Reference pathway under one policy snapshot; not a reconstructed historical cohort.

stages.label: K–2
stages.title: Kindergarten through Grade 2
stages.description: Explore the opening grades of the reference pathway. Learning expectations for these grades have not yet been modeled.

stages.title: Grades 3 through 5
stages.description: Learning expectations for these grades have not yet been modeled. An empty stage does not mean students have no learning requirements.

stages.title: Grades 6 through 8
stages.description: Two Grade 7 families are traced: mathematics NY-7.RP.2 and ELA 7R1. Grades 6 and 8 and the rest of Grade 7 remain unmapped.

stages.title: Grades 9 through 12
stages.description: High-school learning expectations and course arrangements have not yet been modeled. Grade selection does not imply a particular course sequence.

stages.label: Graduation / transition
stages.title: Graduation and what follows
stages.description: Learning expectations, diploma eligibility, and post-school destinations are separate questions. This model does not yet determine diploma eligibility or assign a destination.

projection_rule: Select Standard nodes linked to the selected grade by ASSIGNED_TO_GRADE. Both avatars use this same rule. Show exact edition applicability as unresolved; never infer mastery, cumulative retention, promotion, or graduation.
missing_data_message: This grade is not yet mapped. No claim about the absence of NYS expectations follows from this gap.
review_status: Monday baseline independently audited; Tuesday expansion builder-reviewed; human review pending
